seo_buy_title: AutoRig Unlimited Monthly ($20) and Blender Plugin
seo_buy_description: AutoRig Unlimited Monthly, $20/month: unlimited V3 rigging with animation clips and textures, private models, gallery control. Blender plugin sold separately.
buy_page_intro: Create unlimited models for $20/month. Every model runs on the V3 conveyor: fast rig, animation clips, textures and exports. Keep models private when needed and control whether your work appears in the public gallery.
buy_product_credits_desc: One recurring plan covers unlimited model creation for a full month. Every task runs on the V3 conveyor.
buy_product_credits_point_1: Upload a 3D model (GLB, FBX, OBJ, ZIP), a picture or a picture of a car.
buy_product_plugin_point_2: Use the same rig direction for humanoids, animals, creatures and other shapes.
buy_credits_section_intro: One plan for the complete web app: unlimited model creation for one month on the V3 conveyor, private models, and gallery visibility controls. The subscription renews automatically every month until cancelled.
buy_plan_feature_v3: Fast rig, animation clips and textures for every model
buy_plugin_price_default: Assigned test price loads at checkout.
buy_feedback_placeholder: What do you think about the RIG? What should we improve?
buy_inc_intro: Every task runs on the same V3 conveyor: from a 3D model, a picture or a picture of a car, in nine rig categories (biped, quadruped, equine, bird, serpent, monster, multilimb, hands, vehicle).
buy_inc_1_d: The skeleton and the skin are built from the geometry in seconds. The target is a rigged, animated model within one minute from pickup.
buy_inc_2_d: Clips from the category library are retargeted at once, and every clip passes a numeric deformation check.
buy_inc_3_d: A model's own textures are kept. A model without textures gets PBR textures automatically.
buy_inc_4_d: Joint placement, skin tears, limb collisions and deformation are checked in the background of the viewer.
buy_inc_5_d: One viewer per task: blueprint mode, environment scenes and a session agent chat.
buy_inc_6_d: GLB, FBX, USDZ, ZIP, Unity package and Blender.
